notes: Fix 'delete all scenes leaves one' + add a proper empty state. The leftover was a UI orphan: in Timeline view the current scene's card lives in a full-screen editor overlay, and emptying the scenes never tore it down, so it kept showing the last deleted scene. Now: deleting the last scene clears that orphan; Timeline view stays put and shows a 'Get started — create your first scene' prompt INSIDE the editor stage (topbar/Exit/Generate intact); List/Scene-Editor view shows the same prompt in the panel. Also hardened deletion: loadSegments() now has a render-generation guard so a stale overlapping render can't redraw a deleted card; deleteScene awaits the reload, checks res.ok, and shares an in-flight latch so fast double-clicks can't storm stale indices. Added an atomic 'Delete all' button (scenes toolbar + Timeline editor topbar) backed by a new POST /clear-scenes endpoint that writes [] in one shot.
